name: aws_vpc
description: Provides a VPC resource. A VPC is a virtual network dedicated to your AWS account, logically isolated from other virtual networks in the AWS Cloud. You can launch AWS resources in a VPC that you define.
use_cases: Create isolated network environments for your AWS resources
Control inbound and outbound traffic with security groups and network ACLs
Enable private connectivity between AWS services
Set up hybrid networking with on-premises data centers via VPN or Direct Connect

required.name: cidr_block
required.description: The IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC. CIDR can be explicitly set or it can be derived from IPAM using ipv4_ipam_pool_id. Example: '10.0.0.0/16'

optional.name: enable_dns_support
optional.description: A boolean flag to enable/disable DNS support in the VPC. Defaults to true.

optional.name: enable_dns_hostnames
optional.description: A boolean flag to enable/disable DNS hostnames in the VPC. Required for EKS. Defaults to false.

optional.name: instance_tenancy
optional.description: Tenancy option for instances launched into the VPC: 'default' or 'dedicated'. Defaults to 'default'.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: A map of tags to assign to the resource. Required for cost allocation and resource tracking.

best_practices: Use a /16 CIDR block (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16) to allow sufficient IP addresses for future growth
Always enable DNS support and DNS hostnames — required for EKS and many AWS services
Use multiple Availability Zones for high availability (at least 2, preferably 3)
Separate public and private subnets: NAT gateway for private subnet egress
Apply consistent tagging strategy for cost allocation and resource management
Use the 10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 private address ranges to avoid conflicts
Plan CIDR blocks carefully — VPC CIDR cannot be changed after creation
Use VPC Flow Logs for network monitoring and security analysis
security_notes: Never allow 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on Security Groups attached to private resources
Use VPC Flow Logs to detect anomalous traffic patterns
Enable VPC Endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB to avoid public internet traffic
Use Network ACLs as a secondary defense layer (stateless firewall)
Consider AWS PrivateLink for private connectivity to AWS services

common_errors.error: CIDR block conflicts with existing VPC
common_errors.fix: Choose a non-overlapping CIDR range. Use 10.x.0.0/16, 172.16-31.x.0/16, or 192.168.x.0/24

common_errors.error: EKS nodes cannot register with cluster
common_errors.fix: Set enable_dns_hostnames = true and enable_dns_support = true
Delete all dependent resources first: EC2 instances, subnets, internet gateways, security groups
